name: Banh it la gai
summary: Bánh ít lá gai, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, is glutinous rice, ramie leaf, mung bean, and sugar. The cake is round or a cylinder, with a dark green skin and a yellow mung-bean filling.
origin: Listed with bánh su sê on that Da Nang page. A town of origin inside the city was not printed.
howToEat: The page describes the cake and does not describe a dip. Check on arrival.
where: The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street. Check on arrival.
